business_summary: Neo Performance Materials operates the Silmet separation plant in Sillamae, Estonia, described as until recently the only industrial-scale rare-earth separation facility operating commercially in the Western hemisphere outside Asia, and the Narva, Estonia magnet plant targeting 2,000 tonnes/year scaling to 5,000. FY2025 revenue (vendor-normalized, USD) was 478,793,000, roughly flat (+0.6%) versus 475,828,000 in FY2024, with a narrowed net loss of -9,984,000 versus -12,946,000 in FY2024, though operating cash flow swung negative (-53,962,000 versus +51,001,000 in FY2024).

exposure_summary.narrative: NEO carries two ACTIVE placements: the money-corner, UNDISCOVERED rare-earth-separation-capacity link via Silmet, and the CROWDED magnet-manufacturing-capacity link via Narva, making it one of the few vertically integrated separation-to-magnet operators outside China on this chain.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: Neo Performance Materials does not disclose a separate Silmet/rare-earth-separation revenue percentage in the yfinance-normalized statements fetched this run; the company also operates a chemicals & oxides and magnetics segment mix that vendor statements do not break out by chain link.

latest_fy.basis: Total revenue (USD, vendor-normalized statement currency) for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements vendor block; not a filing quote.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: One-year revenue growth computed as (478793000/475828000)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, fiscal year ended 2024-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 (both USD, vendor-normalized); the field name suggests a 3-year window but only a 1-year change is computed here.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 31,754,000 divided by revenue 478,793,000, both USD (vendor-normalized) for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow -53,962,000 divided by net income -9,984,000, both USD (vendor-normalized) for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31. Operating cash outflow far exceeded the net loss.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt (total_debt 105,538,000 less cash 38,360,000 = 67,178,000) divided by EBITDA (operating income 31,754,000 plus depreciation 15,006,000 = 46,760,000), both USD (vendor-normalized) at/for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.
